bio.short: I am product manager, product owner and design lead for the Bibel TV app redesign — one seat holding strategy, the AI roadmap and UI quality for a consumer product. The AI features I built are in production: a support copilot, a fundraising ecosystem built solo, and an AI feature whose redesign more than doubled weekly starts. I prototype in real code, engineering ships from it, and I camp.
bio.long:
At Bibel TV I hold product management, product ownership and design for a consumer app redesign across iOS, Android, web and connected TV. The AI features are in production, not on slides. A support copilot drafts viewer letters in the company's voice from the support handbook, with an explicit restricted-topic list and every send decision human. An end-to-end AI fundraising ecosystem I built solo runs from the analysis of which letters over-performed to a Claude skill carrying one message into in-app, web and video. The KI Bibelaufschlag feature I designed full scope: its redesign took weekly starts up +153% on iOS and +85% on Android (GA4, four-week averages). AI search and chat are on my roadmap now in the Video Study Bible project, in development.

The same seat holds the design system. A four-tier token architecture, Storybook as the source of truth, and checks in CI that refuse off-system work let product managers and the external engineering partner build self-serve. I prototype in real code against production APIs, and engineering ships from that code. Before Bibel TV I led five designers and writers at Ninox, and ran product with three PMs and a data scientist as interim Head of Product. At ChurchDesk I embedded a booking capability into the platform: 70% less coordination time, 90% acceptance. E-commerce shipped at Spreadshirt (seller-experience redesign after two failed attempts, A/B-tested) and HairDirect (the first mobile orders). German native, English C2, Berlin. And I camp.

The posting screens out process managers — show builder verbs, real code, measured results.
